title: Stable Magnetic Lorentz-Violating Vacua in Gauge-Invariant Nonlinear Electrodynamics
summary: We investigate gauge-invariant nonlinear electrodynamics in the Plebański first-order Hamiltonian formulation, taking the single-invariant potential $\hat V(P)$ as the primary object. Our focus is on the existence of stable Lorentz-violating magnetic vacua. For three explicit two-parameter models -- rational asymmetric, logarithmic, and exponential -- we determine the regions of parameter space in which nontrivial constant electromagnetic vacua are compatible with an effective Hamiltonian bounded from below and a positive-semidefinite Hessian.
